title: Record received, split or partial payments
summary: Save money you have actually received and keep unpaid balances visible.

sections.title: Confirm the money was received
sections.body: Start with the correct saved sale. Check any payments and applied deposit already recorded. Successful external card, transfer or online payments must already have happened before you record them here. A pending or failed payment is not a receipt.

sections.title: Record one or more methods
sections.body:
1. Under **Record payment received**, choose the actual payment method, such as **Cash**, **External card** or **Bank transfer**. **Payment link** records a successful external link payment; it does not create or send a payment link. **UPI** is shown for supported India or INR contexts.
2. Enter **Amount received** in the sale’s currency.
3. For cash, **Cash tendered (optional)** can calculate change. Record the amount allocated to the sale, rather than the full banknote handed over.
4. For another method, optionally enter its terminal or transfer **Reference**.
5. If the client used several methods, select **Add to split payment** for each received part. Review the staged amounts and remaining balance.
6. Confirm **I have received [amount]** only after checking the money.
7. Select the **Record** button for the shown amount and wait for completion.

sections.title: Verify the result
sections.body:
A full payment completes the sale and makes the final receipt available. A partial payment leaves the rest outstanding on the same sale. **Pay later** keeps the saved sale outstanding and records no successful payment.

Check **Payments recorded** or **Review sale & payments** before recording another amount. The sale’s saved balance limits what can be recorded. If the response is interrupted, use the pending-request recovery controls and do not take money again.
